subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers land the linked cross-repository cleanup PR, replace it with a same-repo cleanup PR, or close that candidate and keep this issue as the canonical bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open PR already references this issue with closing syntax and ClawSweeper should not queue a competing fix until maintainers choose that path.

options.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
options.body: Refresh and review the linked cleanup candidate, then either land it with proof or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

options.title: Close candidate, keep issue
options.body: Close the linked PR if it is not usable and leave this issue open as the canonical source-reproducible bug.

options.title: Defer placeholder cleanup
options.body: Leave the issue unresolved if maintainers want to sequence this behind broader Google Chat delivery lifecycle work.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
recommendation.body: Refresh and review the linked cleanup candidate, then either land it with proof or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.
